posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal's baby boy Vihaan Kaushal's first photo melts the internet, with Kareena Kapoor welcoming her to the 'Mamma Club' as Katrina glows in new post-pregnancy appearances.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit reveals Shakira wants an Indian twist on 'Hips Don't Lie' and opens up about the Toronto University course dedicated to him during a Jimmy Fallon appearance.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia challenged the Indian film industry's overemphasis on male audiences at Cannes and dazzled at Milan Fashion Week, continuing her global fashion and advocacy push.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Nick Jonas reveals toddler Malti Marie's favorite jams while Priyanka shares heartwarming family moments in her 'Random March' series on social media.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King is nearing the end of its shoot as SRK also considers a mature romantic drama for his next project — meanwhile Lalit Modi reveals the untold story behind Khan's KKR investment.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wraps the Daayra shoot and attends sister Karisma's 'Brown' screening with Saif, while proud mom moment: Taimur earns his yellow belt in Taekwondo.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha suffers a fracture while shooting Eetha but powers through, praising beau Rahul Mody and learning Lavni dance for her upcoming biopic role.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is using a body double for high-octane action scenes in Atlee's Raka alongside Allu Arjun amid reports of her second pregnancy, while also filming King with SRK.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: FWICE withdraws its non-cooperation directive against Ranveer over the Don 3 exit as his Dhurandhar franchise races toward a massive Rs 2,000 crore worldwide collection.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya returns to Mumbai with daughter Aaradhya after a stunning run at Paris Fashion Week and Cannes, mother-daughter twinning in chic black outfits at the airport.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika launches the Cocktail 2 trailer alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon, and shares the Anime Awards stage with Winston Duke in a cross-cultural moment.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Newlywed Samantha marries Raj Nidimoru in a dreamy ceremony; husband rushes to pick her up after a fan mobbing incident, and her new film Maa Inti Bangaaram teaser drops.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone joins Allu Arjun's upcoming Atlee-directed Raka with body doubles handling her action sequences — the Pushpa star's next blockbuster takes shape.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi explodes at the box office with a Rs 69 crore opening day crossing Rs 100 crore in its first weekend, with Janhvi Kapoor and AR Rahman's score earning rave reviews.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: The first glimpse of Dragon with Prashanth Neel sends fans into a frenzy, while War 2 with Hrithik Roshan nears release and Shahid Kapoor enters talks for Dragon's villain role.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in the blockbuster Peddi, visits Tirupati temple for blessings, and charms fans by expressing her deep love for 1980s Bollywood films.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya celebrates her birthday early on set while Call Me Bae Season 2 is confirmed — her next film Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya is also in the works.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara opens up about motherhood and postpartum life with baby Saraayah, calls her upcoming film Toxic with Yash 'complete drama,' and confirms her War 2 role.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik announces his directorial debut and a new production venture focused on social thrillers, while ramping up War 2 promotions and making a joint property purchase with father Rakesh Roshan.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with father David Dhawan hits screens, while Delhi High Court issues a landmark ruling protecting his personality rights against unauthorized AI-generated content.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya buys a luxurious Rs 29.7 crore apartment in Mumbai's Worli, drops a live album from her All Hearts Tour, and reveals she once turned down recording 'Fevicol Se.'

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman's score for Peddi with Ram Charan breaks the myth about his films underperforming, as he speaks at IGF London on AI's future in cinema and prepares Le Musk's London premiere.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's swan song film Jana Nayagan faces censor and piracy hurdles as CBFC clearance is expected soon — marking his emotional farewell to cinema before his full transition to politics.
